themes.name: Dusk
themes.description: Dark surface, warm paper-white ink, one accent. Display type set tight with optical sizing; body set loose.

themes.name: Daybreak
themes.description: Warm paper surface, near-black ink, one deep teal accent. Same families, roles, layouts, and presets as Dusk: a deck moves between them by swapping the file.

themes.name: Ember
themes.description: Near-black surface, warm white ink, one signal orange. Serif claims and figures over a neutral sans; data in quiet grays with the orange spent on the point.

themes.name: Gallery
themes.description: Gallery white, ink black, one cobalt accent: Instrument Serif headlines set large over Inter. The same roles, layouts, and presets as Dusk and Daybreak: a deck moves between them by swapping the file.

themes.name: Basel
themes.description: Swiss: flush-left Inter at huge sizes on warm white, red the only color, hairlines on the grid's lines. Needs no font beyond the four's.

themes.name: Kernel
themes.description: Systems: titles in JetBrains Mono over Inter on a dark ground, a terminal green accent, and code cards that read at the back of a hall. Needs no font beyond the four's.
